content: Kuku binga-bingandamun ngadimunku.

Jew-warra wubulku mara julurrijinya mayi nukanjiku, jana yalaku. Jana julurrijin yalaku binga-bingangka ngadimunku balkan. Binga-bingangka ngadimunku yalaman, “Kaki mara kari julurriji mumbarku, bamangka law ngujakuramunku buyun-damal.” Kaki bama Jew townmun kaday, nyulu mara julurrijika, nukanjiku. Binga-bingangka jananda yalarrku law yindu-yindu dajin ngujakuraku. Jana must pannikan, billycan mumbarabuku julurrika, buyun kidanka. Jana Pharisee-warrangka law ngujakura mumbarabuku wukurrin. Jana, teacher-teacher lawku ngadimunku townmun Jerusalemmun kadarin, murumarinda Jesusanda. Jana Jesusamu jawun-karra nyajin mayi nukal-nukanya. Yamba Jesusamu jawun-karra kari mara julurrijin, mayi nukanjiku.
Jana, Pharisee-warrangka, teacher-teacherangka lawku ngadimunku, jana Jesusanda yalaman, “Yunu jawun-karra mara kari julurrijin, mayi nukanka. Jana law kari wukurrin.”
Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Ngadi-ngadiku Isaiahangka Godumu kuku kabanba balkan. Nyulu yurranka balkan, yurra jurril. Godundumundu kabanda balkal,

content.text: ‘Godungku yalaman, “Jana ngaykunku ngulkurrku balkan-balkaway. Yamba jana bulu-duray, ngaykunku wawu kari.
Jana wumbaku ngaykundu praymal, jurrilmal-jurrilmal, jana nganya kari kuku nyajinya. Jana kari binal-bungal kukuku ngayuku balkan. Jana binal-bungal kukuku bamangkaku balkan.” ’

content: Yurra God kari kuku nyajil, yurra bamaku kuku nyajil.”
Jesusangka jananda yalaman baja, “Yurra jurrilda Godumu way wukurrinka, yamba yurra wawubu yurrangaku way wukurrinka. Yurra Godumu law bawankuda.
Ngadi-ngadiku Mosesangka Godumu law kabanba balkan. Nyulu balkan,

content.text: ‘Yurra nganjan, and ngamu kuku nyaka, ngulkurrduku kuji. Kaki yundu nganjan, and ngamu yukil, bamangka yunun yarkinkaku kuni.’

content: Yamba yurra yinya Godumu kuku walu-yindu-bungan. Yurra wadu-waduku balkalda, ‘Bama nyubun nguba junjuynji, ngamundu, nganjananda dajinyaku, bulanin helpim-bunganka. Yamba nyulu nguba wawu kari bulanda dajinka. Yinyaynka nyulu Godundumunbu bayanba wundi, kanbal priest-warranda dajinka, kanbal wundinka baja bayanbaku.’ Yinyamun nyulu kari bulanda dajil baja, bulangan kari ngulkurrduku kujil baja.
Yurrawundu lawmundu Godumu kuku kanbinda. Yurra yalaku jurrilmalmal.”
Yinyamundu bama buyunmal.
Jesusangka bama wubulku kunjan, nyungundu kadarinka. Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Yurra milka-janay, binalmaka, kuku nyaka.

Kaki yundu mayi nukal, yundu yinya mayi ngandalba walay-manil. Yinyangka mayibu yunun kari buyun-damal. Kaki yundu kuku buyun-buyun balkal, yinya kuku ngandalmun dakal. Yinyangka kukubu yunun buyun-damalda, buyun-buyun dukurrmun dakanya.
Kaki yurra binalmanka, yurra milka-janay mumbarku.”
Jana, Jesus, jawun-karra bayanba walarin, bama wubulku bawan. Jawun-karrangka Jesusanda babajin, “Yinya kuku balka, milkanga-bunga.”
Nyulu jananda babajin, “Yurra binal kari yinyaynka kukuku? Kaki yundu junjuy-junjuy nukal, yinyamundu mayibu yunun kari buyun-damal.
Mayi waralba walal, yinyamun dungay baja. Mayi dukurrbu kari walal. Yinyamundu mayibu yunun kari buyun-damal.” Yinyamundu Jesusangka balkan yalada mayi wubulku nukanka.
Nyulu yalaman, “Yundu dukurrmun junjuy-junjuynku buyunku balkal, yinyamundu yunun buyun-damal.
Bamangka milkabu wukurril buyun, yinya dukurrmun. Yinyaynka nyulu kalngarmanka, wurrmaymanka, yarkinkaku kuninka,
jumbunmanka, buyunmanka, jurrilmanka, money-bakamanka, ngura-nyajinka, binda-damanka, bulmbuymanka, kiru-kari bajaku.
Yinyarrinyangka buyun-buyundu bama buyun-bungal, dukurrmun dakanya.”
Nyubun jalbu Jesusanda milka-janan.
Wawu yinyamun Jesus dungan, bubungu yubaku townbu jambulbu Tyre, and Sidon, bayanba bundandan. Nyulu wawu kari bama binalmanka nyulu yinyaymba. Yamba bama binalman nyulu yinyaymba.
Nyubun jalbu bundandan yinyaymba. Ngadiku dubu nyunguwunbu kangkalanda jalbundu dukurrbu walan. Yinyayangka ngamungku kuku nyajin Jesusanka, nyulu jinbalku Jesusanda kadan, bungkubu janan.

Jew-warra wawu kari bamanka walu-yinduynku. Jana yalamal, “Jana bama yala kaya.” Yinya jalbu Jew kari, nyulu Gentile, nyungu bubu yubaku townbu jambulbu Tyre, and Sidon, nyungu kuku Greek. Jalbungku Jesusanda babajin, “Yundu ngaykundumun kangkalandamun dukurrmun dubu kangangarr?”
Jesusangka nyungundu yalaman, “Nganjin mayi dajil kaykay-kaykayandangarr. Bamangka mayi kaykay-kaykayamu kari kayanga yilbal.”
Jalbungku Jesusanda yalaman, “Yaladabi, Maja. Kaykay-kaykayangka mayida nukal, mayi yanday bubungu daray. Kayangka yinya mayi yanday nukalda.”
Jesusangka nyungundu yalaman, “Yundu yinya kuku ngaykundu yalamanya, ngayu yunu kangkal ngulkurr-bungan. Yundu dungayda. Dubu dungaynda yunuwunmun kangkalandamun dukurrmun.”
Jalbu bayanbaku dunganda. Nyulu bayanba kadan, kangkal warrmba-bungan wunananya bedba. Dubu dungaynda.
Jesusangka bama milka-kari, kuku-kari ngulkurr-bungan.
Wawu yinyamun Jesus bubumun yubamun townmun Tyremun dungan, towndurr Sidondurr dungan, bububurr Ten Townsmundurr dungan, jalunbu Galilee kadan.
Kanbalda bamangka dingkar wundin Jesusanda, milka-kari, kuku-kari. Jana wawu Jesusangka dingkar marabu karrbanka, ngulkurr-bunganka.
Jesusangka yinya dingkar bamandamun wubulmunku wundin, mara milkanga yijarrin, nyumba yilban, nyabil karrban.
Nyulu jiri nyajin, wawu yilban, nyunguwundu kukubu yalaman, “Abada.” Yinya mean, “Milka walngajika!”
Dingkaramu milka walngajinda, ngulkurrkuda, nyulu kuku yirrkanda. Nyulu kuku ngulkurrku balkan-balkawanda.
Jesusangka bamanda yalaman, “Yurra kari balka yinyaynka.” Yamba jana dungarin, wubulku balkan. Jesusangka balkan baja, “Kari balka.” Yamba jana dungarin baja, balkan baja.
Jana bama kungkurr-kadarin, yalaman, “Nyulu junjuy-junjuy ngulkurrduku balkal. Nyulu bama milka-buyun ngulkurr-bungal, bama kuku-kari kukuji-bungal.”
